sources.quote: 4.2 A supplier may deliver a part only if the approved supplier list contains an approval for that
Correct, the audit qualifies the company. Part approvals stay as they are.

findings.why: The ASL has no approval for Meccanica Chisone (SUP-C) on PN-050. The only approval for PN-050 is SUP-G at PLT-BEI for Aurelia. SUP-C's return to 'approved' on 2026-11-06 qualifies the company only and gives no part approval.

sources.quote: The supplier shall obtain written approval from Aurelia (PPAP resubmission) before shipping parts
Approval is granted per part number and per manufacturing site.

findings.why: A new source for PN-050 (program PRG-X, customer Aurelia) is a change of source. Revision 4 of the Aurelia manual requires written approval (PPAP) before shipment, and also notification 90 days ahead. Nothing in force covers this: the approvals are per part and site, and the deviations on file concern other parts.
The drawing requires Steel 42CrMo4. Meccanica Chisone is qualified only for EN AW-6061-T6 and EN AW-6082-T5 (aluminium), so it has no recorded capability for the drawing material.

sources.quote: 4.4 A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for

findings.why: There is no 3.1 certificate from SUP-C for MAT-42CRMO4. The supplier quality engineer (E. Gallo) must clarify whether one exists.
